name: Horam
title: King of Gezer
summary: Horam was the king of Gezer who came to help the city of Lachish in battle against Joshua and the Israelites during the conquest of Canaan. He and his entire army were defeated by Joshua, and none survived. He is an example of the Canaanite kings who tried to resist Israel's entry into the promised land.

keyEvents.title: Horam Comes to Lachish's Aid
keyEvents.description: When Joshua attacked and captured the city of Lachish, King Horam of Gezer went up to help Lachish against the Israelites.

keyEvents.title: Horam's Defeat
keyEvents.description: Joshua defeated Horam and all his people so that none were left. This was part of the great southern campaign.

keyEvents.title: The Southern Coalition Defeated
keyEvents.description: Horam's attempt to help Lachish was part of a broader conflict in which several Canaanite kings in the south tried to resist Joshua's conquest, but all were defeated.

keyEvents.title: Joshua's Conquest of Lachish
keyEvents.description: Joshua besieged and captured Lachish in two days, which prompted Horam's attempt to come to the city's aid. The king of Lachish, Japhia, was killed.

keyEvents.title: Gezer Remains Unconquered
keyEvents.description: Although Horam was defeated, the city of Gezer itself was not completely conquered by the Israelites at this time. Gezer remained partially inhabited by Canaanites for a long time afterward.
